title: ASP.NET Core developer exception page disclosed in a response
description: The response is the ASP.NET Core developer exception page: it carries the framework's unhandled-exception heading and references the Microsoft.AspNetCore assemblies. The page prints the exception, the stack trace, the request and, depending on configuration, the source lines around the failure.
remediation: Run the application with the Production environment name so the developer exception page is not registered, and return a generic error page instead.
limitation: Two body markers. A generic ASP.NET stack trace without the developer page heading is reported by the .NET stack-frame rule instead.

check.valuePattern: (?=[\s\S]*An unhandled exception occurred while processing the request)(?=[\s\S]*Microsoft\.AspNetCore)

observation.body:
An unhandled exception occurred while processing the request.

InvalidOperationException: boom at Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics.DeveloperExceptionPageMiddleware
An unhandled exception occurred while processing the request. See Microsoft.AspNetCore.Server.Kestrel output.
